locator.section: Missa dominicæ I post Epiphaniam, Sequéntia sancti Evangélii secúndum Lucam, Luc. 2, 42-52

entries.claim: The Mass of the First Sunday after the Epiphany prints this Gospel in full. Its letters and accents equal page 40 and the selected text; it has commas after cognátos (inter cognátos, et notos), illos (audiéntem illos, et interrogántem), tuus (pater tuus, et ego) and his (in his, quæ), and lower-case ecce and nesciebátis after the question marks, where page 40 and the selected text have none of these commas and Ecce, Nesciebátis.
The cited page image prints and identifies the complete 1962 liturgical component selected here; shared expansions are bounded in the witness record.
